data.subject: Quick question about API docs
data.body_text:
Hey Alex,

I am onboarding two new devs next week and wanted to point them to the API documentation. Is the Swagger spec in /docs/api up to date, or should I direct them to the wiki instead? Also, did we ever document the rate limiting changes from last sprint?

data.subject: URGENT: API Latency Spike - Production
data.body_text:
Alex,

We are seeing p99 latency spike to 2.3s on the user-service API (normally ~200ms). Started about 5 minutes ago. Grafana dashboard shows the issue is isolated to the /api/v2/users endpoints. I am investigating the database connection pool but could use your eyes on the application logs. Can you check if anything looks off in the recent deployment?

Joining incident channel now.

Emily

data.subject: Re: API Latency Incident - Status?
data.body_text:
Alex,

I saw Emily's alert. What's the current status? Leadership is asking for an update. Let me know if you need me to pull in additional resources or run interference with stakeholders.

Sarah

data.subject: Re: API Latency Incident - Fix Deployed
data.body_text:
Team,

Good news - fix has been deployed. Root cause was a missing index on the new user_preferences table from yesterday's migration. I've added the index and latency is back to normal (~180ms p99). Will document this in the post-mortem.

Marcus

data.subject: Post-Mortem Summary: API Latency Incident (2026-01-16)
data.body_text:
Hi all,

Quick post-mortem summary for this morning's incident:

Impact: ~30 min of degraded performance on user-service API
Root Cause: Missing database index on user_preferences table after migration
Resolution: Index added by Marcus, latency restored
Action Items:
- Add index verification to migration checklist
- Set up alerting for slow query detection
- Review other recent migrations for similar issues

Full post-mortem doc linked in #incidents. Great teamwork today!

Emily
